inputs.seed_scheme: numpy default_rng([step seed, configuration index, dataset index])

rules.scope: step3-scope/1 (entry 106): every level of C2 (two-sided, a new statistic: nothing carries over from the one-sided calibration) and the levels that failed step 2 (each claim's reachable levels outside its step-2 usable set: C1a two-family s = 6, C5 s = 2 and 3); every other level keeps its alpha' and its step-2 verdict
rules.selection: selection/2: alpha'(a) the largest grid value j x 0.0005 a (j <= 4000) whose one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the size is <= a in every null configuration of the claim, then step 1's monotone snap from the largest level down; a repaired level at most the next larger level's alpha' and unusable below the next smaller kept level's; C2's test by entry 46's rule on the selection run, a repaired level keeps its claim's step-1 test; C2 on the selection run's draws, a repaired claim in each null configuration on every draw that applies, pooled (steps 1 and 2's and the selection run's)
rules.validation: validation/1: on fresh draws (the validation seed, N3 per configuration) step 2's rule per selected level (size <= a + 2 SE, else unusable), then the six-claim FWER <= alpha + 2 SE in every configuration with the final usable levels; a failed FWER check gives every claim p = 1
